sentences.text: 演出前，我在舞台後方等候。
sentences.spokenText: 演出前我在舞台後方等候
sentences.imageNotes: 從舞台後方的準備區觀看，主角女孩站在布幕後等候上台，老師在近旁照看；透過布幕開口可見前方舞台。女孩確實位於舞台後方，不是台中央、觀眾席或單純站在舞台旁邊；不需誇張緊張表情。
sentences.imagePrompt: Use the approved L058 lesson images only as style references: warm modern children’s picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework, soft natural light, detailed but clean environments, expressive preschool proportions, bright warm palette, and phone-readable square composition. Do not copy any specific L058 person. Match the refined preferred style/proportions and recurring cast anchors from L115, L118, L119, L128, L154, L162, and L163. No visible text, letters, numbers, logos, captions, labels, or watermarks. Backstage preparation area before a performance. The recurring preschool protagonist girl with short dark bob and pink hair clip waits calmly behind a heavy stage curtain while the recurring teacher, visually distinct from the mother, watches nearby. Through a narrow curtain opening, the lit front stage is clearly visible in the distance. The girl is unmistakably behind the stage, not center stage, in the audience, or merely beside the platform. Natural calm anticipation, no exaggerated fear. Square 1:1 composition.

sentences.text: 這位演員從小就很會跳舞。
sentences.spokenText: 這位演員從小就很會跳舞
sentences.imageNotes: 一位 generic adult 演員拿著自己的童年照片，照片中同一人在幼年熟練跳舞；成年人物與童年照片保留一致的髮色、臉型特徵，明確表示同一人的過去。主角女孩可以在旁看照片。演員不是固定爸爸、媽媽、小月或小光；照片不放日期、姓名或說明文字。

The adult and the dancing child in the photo share unmistakable hair color, face shape, and a small distinctive hair feature so they clearly represent the same person at different ages. The child in the photo dances skillfully. The recurring protagonist girl may look at the photo nearby. The photograph contains only the childhood scene, with no date, name, caption, or readable writing. Square 1:1 composition.

sentences.text: 爸爸上台演唱我愛聽的歌。
sentences.spokenText: 爸爸上台演唱我愛聽的歌
sentences.imageNotes: 主角爸爸在社區或親子活動的小舞台上拿麥克風唱歌，主角女孩坐在台下專心聽、神情開心；爸爸是固定主角爸爸，不是陌生歌手。畫面不需要可讀歌詞或歌曲名稱。

sentences.text: 全班演練起火時怎麼走出去。
sentences.spokenText: 全班演練起火時怎麼走出去
sentences.imageNotes: 學校進行消防疏散演練，老師帶主角女孩與多名 generic classmates 有秩序地沿教室出口往室外走，讓人看出是全班練習路線，不是只有兩個孩子。沒有真的起火，不畫火焰、濃煙、驚慌逃跑或受傷；不依賴可讀標語交代情境。

The recurring teacher, distinct from the mother, calmly leads the recurring protagonist girl and a visibly full class of many varied generic preschool classmates in an orderly line from the classroom doorway toward the safe outdoor school area. The route and group movement make it clearly a whole-class practice. No flames, smoke, panic, running, injury, emergency damage, or readable signs. Keep recurring and generic children visually distinct. Square 1:1 composition.

sentences.imageNotes: 車站候車室內，主角女孩與主角哥哥坐在等候座椅上看書，媽媽在旁陪同；旅行袋、其他等候乘客及窗外停靠的車輛交代車站情境。人物在室內，不畫成車廂內或路邊公車亭；書頁內容不必看清。

They are clearly indoors in a waiting room, not inside a vehicle or at a roadside bus shelter. Preserve the approved protagonist family identities; keep book pages unreadable.
